answers.1:
kubectl port-forward svc/web 8080:80 -n $NS >/dev/null 2>&1 &
PF=$!
sleep 3
curl -s localhost:8080 > /tmp/q1.txt
kill $PF
grep -o 'Welcome to nginx' /tmp/q1.txt

# 포워딩은 명령이 살아 있는 동안만 유지된다. 끝나면 kill 로 종료한다
answers.2:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: memp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - {name: cache, mountPath: /cache}
  volumes:
  - name: cache
    emptyDir: {medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 64Mi}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/memp -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec memp -n $NS -- mount | grep ' /cache '

# tmpfs on /cache type tmpfs ... 로 보인다
answers.3:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: projp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - {name: all, mountPath: /etc/proj}
  volumes:
  - name: all
    projected:
      sources:
      - configMap: {name: p-cm}
      - secret: {name: p-sec}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/projp -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec projp -n $NS -- ls /etc/proj

# 서로 다른 출처의 키가 한 폴더 안의 파일이 된다 (키 이름이 겹치면 안 된다)
answers.4:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: subp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.25
    volumeMounts:
    - name: extra
      mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html/extra.txt
      subPath: extra.txt
  volumes:
  - name: extra
    configMap: {name: extra-cm}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/subp -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec subp -n $NS -- ls /usr/share/nginx/html

# index.html 과 extra.txt 가 함께 있다. 폴더째 마운트했다면 index.html 이 사라진다
answers.5:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: rfp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
    resources:
      limits: {memory: 128Mi, cpu: 500m}
    env:
    - name: MEM_LIMIT
      valueFrom:
        resourceFieldRef: {resource: limits.memory, divisor: 1Mi}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/rfp -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec rfp -n $NS -- printenv MEM_LIMIT

# divisor 가 없으면 바이트 값(134217728)이 들어간다
answers.6:
kubectl patch svc web -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"ClientIP"}}'
kubectl get svc web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.sessionAffinity}'

# 기본값은 None. 가능하면 앱을 상태 없이 만들고 이 설정은 쓰지 않는다
answers.7:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: spread}
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: spread}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: spread}
    spec:
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
        whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels: {app: spread}
      containers:
      - {name: web, image: "nginx:1.25"}
EOF
kubectl rollout status deployment/spread -n $NS --timeout=120s

# 노드가 둘 이상이면 노드마다 1개씩 퍼진다
answers.8:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata: {name: web-hpa}
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: {apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: web}
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 4
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: memory
      target: {type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 80}
EOF
kubectl get hpa web-hpa -n $NS

# 사용률은 requests 대비 비율이라 requests 가 없으면 TARGETS 가 <unknown> 으로 보인다
answers.9:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: dnsp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  dnsConfig:
    options:
    - {name: ndots, value: "2"}
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/dnsp -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec dnsp -n $NS -- cat /etc/resolv.conf

# options ndots:2 로 바뀐다. 값이 작을수록 외부 이름을 곧바로 질의한다
